dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Hello. Do you have a loyalty card with us?
dialogue.reading: həˈloʊ. duː juː ˈhæv ə ˈlɔɪəlti ˌkɑːrd wɪð ˈʌs?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No, I don't. Is it free?
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, aɪ ˈdoʊnt. ɪz ɪt ˈfriː?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Yes. The membership is free, as long as you spend over five hundred baht today.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. ðə ˈmɛmbərʃɪp ɪz ˈfriː, əz ˈlɔːŋ əz juː ˈspɛnd ˈoʊvər ˈfaɪv ˈhʌndrəd ˈbɑːt təˈdeɪ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: OK. What do I get with it?
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. ˈwʌt duː aɪ ˈɡɛt wɪð ɪt?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: You get points every time you shop, and a discount on your birthday.
dialogue.reading: juː ˈɡɛt ˈpɔɪnts ˈɛvri ˈtaɪm juː ˈʃɑːp, ənd ə ˈdɪskaʊnt ɑːn jʊr ˈbɜːrθdeɪ.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: They're valid for one year, so use them before they expire.
dialogue.reading: ðɛr ˈvælɪd fər ˈwʌn ˈjɪr, ˈsoʊ ˈjuːz ðɛm bɪˈfɔːr ðeɪ ɪkˈspaɪər.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: And can I return things if they don't fit?
dialogue.reading: ənd kən aɪ rɪˈtɜːrn ˈθɪŋz ɪf ðeɪ ˈdoʊnt ˈfɪt?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Yes, as long as you bring the receipt and the price tag is still on.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, əz ˈlɔːŋ əz juː ˈbrɪŋ ðə rɪˈsiːt ənd ðə ˈpraɪs ˌtæɡ ɪz ˈstɪl ˈɑːn.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Thirty days. You can read the full terms and conditions on our app.
dialogue.reading: ˈθɜːrti ˈdeɪz. juː kən ˈriːd ðə ˈfʊl ˈtɜːrmz ənd kənˈdɪʃənz ɑːn aʊr ˈæp.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Great. As long as I don't have to read all of it, I'm happy!
dialogue.reading: ˈɡreɪt. əz ˈlɔːŋ əz aɪ ˈdoʊnt ˈhæf tə ˈriːd ˈɔːl əv ɪt, aɪm ˈhæpi!
